title: पञ्चत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: At Raibhya's hermitage Lomasha tells of Yavakri, son of Bharadvaja, who resolved to learn the Vedas by austerity alone without a teacher. Indra tried to dissuade him by building a dam of sand in the Ganga, but at last granted him the boon of knowing the Vedas.
summary.kn: ರೈಭ್ಯಾಶ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಲೋಮಶರು ಗುರುವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ತಪಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದಲೇ ವೇದ ಕಲಿಯಲು ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸಿದ ಭರದ್ವಾಜನ ಮಗ ಯವಕ್ರೀತನ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಂದ್ರನು ಗಂಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮರಳಿನ ಕಟ್ಟೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ತಡೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರೂ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ವೇದಜ್ಞಾನದ ವರ ನೀಡಿದನು.
summary.hi: रैभ्य के आश्रम में लोमश भरद्वाज के पुत्र यवक्री की कथा सुनाते हैं, जिन्होंने गुरु के बिना केवल तप से वेद सीखने का निश्चय किया। इन्द्र ने गंगा में बालू का बाँध बनाकर उन्हें रोकने का प्रयास किया, पर अन्त में वेदज्ञान का वर दिया।
summary.te: రైభ్యుని ఆశ్రమంలో లోమశుడు, గురువు లేకుండా తపస్సుతోనే వేదాలు నేర్చుకోవాలని నిశ్చయించిన భరద్వాజుని కుమారుడు యవక్రీతుని కథ చెబుతాడు. ఇంద్రుడు గంగలో ఇసుక ఆనకట్ట కట్టి వారించడానికి ప్రయత్నించినా చివరకు వేదజ్ఞాన వరమిచ్చాడు.
summary.ta: ரைப்யரின் ஆசிரமத்தில் லோமஶர், குருவின்றித் தவத்தால் மட்டுமே வேதம் கற்கத் தீர்மானித்த பரத்வாஜரின் மகன் யவக்ரீயின் கதையைச் சொல்கிறார். இந்திரன் கங்கையில் மணல் அணை கட்டித் தடுக்க முயன்றாலும் இறுதியில் வேத ஞான வரம் அளித்தான்.
summary.ml: രൈഭ്യന്റെ ആശ്രമത്തിൽവെച്ച് ഭരദ്വാജന്റെ പുത്രനായ യവക്രീതന്റെ കഥ ലോമശൻ പറയുന്നു: ഗുരുവില്ലാതെ തപസ്സിലൂടെ മാത്രം വേദം പഠിക്കാൻ അദ്ദേഹം തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു. ഗംഗയിൽ മണൽകൊണ്ട് അണകെട്ടി ഇന്ദ്രൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പിന്തിരിപ്പിക്കാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു; ഒടുവിൽ വേദജ്ഞാനമെന്ന വരം നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.135; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
एषा मधुविला राजन्समङ्गा संप्रकाशते ।
एतत्कर्दमिलं नाम भरतस्याभिषेचनम् ॥

meaning.en: King, this is Madhuvila, shining, and Samanga. This, called Kardamila, is the place of Bharata's consecration.

verses.text:
अलक्ष्म्या किल संयुक्तो वृत्रं हत्वा शचीपतिः ।
आप्लुतः सर्वपापेभ्यः समङ्गायां व्यमुच्यत ॥

meaning.en: They say that Indra, husband of Shachi, after killing Vritra, was possessed by misfortune, and when he bathed in Samanga he was freed from all sins.

verses.text:
एतद्विनशनं कुक्षौ मैनाकस्य नरर्षभ ।
अदितिर्यत्र पुत्रार्थं तदन्नमपचत्पुरा ॥

meaning.en: This, bull among men, is Vinashana at the side of Mainaka, where in ancient times Aditi cooked the food for the sake of a son.

verses.text:
एनं पर्वतराजानमारुह्य पुरुषर्षभ ।
अयशस्यामसंशब्द्यामलक्ष्मीं व्यपनोत्स्यथ ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, climbing this king of mountains, you will cast away the misfortune that brings ill repute and cannot be named.

verses.text:
एते कनखला राजनृषीणां दयिता नगाः ।
एषा प्रकाशते गङ्गा युधिष्ठिर महानदी ॥

meaning.en: King, these are Kanakhala, the hills dear to the seers, and here shines the great river Ganga, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
सनत्कुमारो भगवानत्र सिद्धिमगात्पराम् ।
आजमीढावगाह्यैनां सर्वपापैः प्रमोक्ष्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Here the holy Sanatkumara attained supreme perfection. Descendant of Ajamidha, by bathing in it you will be freed of all sins.

verses.text:
अपां ह्रदं च पुण्याख्यं भृगुतुङ्गं च पर्वतम् ।
तूष्णीं गङ्गां च कौन्तेय सामात्यः समुपस्पृश ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, touch silently, with your ministers, the lake called Punya, the mountain Bhrigutunga, and the Ganga.

verses.text:
आश्रमः स्थूलशिरसो रमणीयः प्रकाशते ।
अत्र मानं च कौन्तेय क्रोधं चैव विवर्जय ॥

meaning.en: The lovely hermitage of Sthulashiras shines here. Son of Kunti, give up pride and anger here.

verses.text:
एष रैभ्याश्रमः श्रीमान्पाण्डवेय प्रकाशते ।
भारद्वाजो यत्र कविर्यवक्रीतो व्यनश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, here shines the glorious hermitage of Raibhya, where the wise Bharadvaja's son Yavakri perished.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कथंयुक्तोऽभवदृषिर्भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
किमर्थं च यवक्रीत ऋषिपुत्रो व्यनश्यत ॥

meaning.en: How did the mighty seer Bharadvaja come to be what he was? And why did Yavakri, the seer's son, perish?

verses.text:
एतत्सर्वं यथावृत्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि लोमश ।
कर्मभिर्देवकल्पानां कीर्त्यमानैर्भृशं रमे ॥

meaning.en: Lomasha, I want to hear all this as it happened. I take great delight in hearing the deeds of those who are like gods.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
भरद्वाजश्च रैभ्यश्च सखायौ संबभूवतुः ।
तावूषतुरिहात्यन्तं प्रीयमाणौ वनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Bharadvaja and Raibhya were friends. They lived here in the forest, very fond of each other.

verses.text:
रैभ्यस्य तु सुतावास्तामर्वावसुपरावसू ।
आसीद्यवक्रीः पुत्रस्तु भरद्वाजस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: Raibhya had two sons, Arvavasu and Paravasu, and Bharadvaja, Bharata, had a son, Yavakri.

verses.text:
रैभ्यो विद्वान्सहापत्यस्तपस्वी चेतरोऽभवत् ।
तयोश्चाप्यतुला प्रीतिर्बाल्यात्प्रभृति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Raibhya was learned and had children, while the other was an ascetic. Yet the two friends had an unequalled affection from childhood on, Bharata.

verses.text:
यवक्रीः पितरं दृष्ट्वा तपस्विनमसत्कृतम् ।
दृष्ट्वा च सत्कृतं विप्रै रैभ्यं पुत्रैः सहानघ ॥

meaning.en: Yavakri, seeing his ascetic father unhonoured, and seeing Raibhya honoured by brahmins together with his sons, sinless one,

verses.text:
पर्यतप्यत तेजस्वी मन्युनाभिपरिप्लुतः ।
तपस्तेपे ततो घोरं वेदज्ञानाय पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: was burned with grief, his brilliance flooded with anger, Pandava. So he practised dreadful austerity to gain knowledge of the Veda.

verses.text:
सुसमिद्धे महत्यग्नौ शरीरमुपतापयन् ।
जनयामास संतापमिन्द्रस्य सुमहातपाः ॥

meaning.en: He tormented his body in a great blazing fire, and that very ascetic caused anguish to Indra.

verses.text:
तत इन्द्रो यवक्रीतमुपगम्य युधिष्ठिर ।
अब्रवीत्कस्य हेतोस्त्वमास्थितस्तप उत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Indra came to Yavakri, Yudhishthira, and said: "For what reason have you undertaken this supreme austerity?"

verses.text: यवक्रीरुवाच

meaning.en: Yavakri said:

verses.text:
द्विजानामनधीता वै वेदाः सुरगणार्चित ।
प्रतिभान्त्विति तप्येऽहमिदं परमकं तपः ॥

meaning.en: The Vedas have not been studied by brahmins, O you honoured by the hosts of gods. I practise this supreme austerity so that they may shine in me.

verses.text:
स्वाध्यायार्थे समारम्भो ममायं पाकशासन ।
तपसा ज्ञातुमिच्छामि सर्वज्ञानानि कौशिक ॥

meaning.en: Punisher of Paka, my undertaking is for the sake of study. Kaushika, I wish to know all knowledge through austerity.

verses.text:
कालेन महता वेदाः शक्या गुरुमुखाद्विभो ।
प्राप्तुं तस्मादयं यत्नः परमो मे समास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Lord, the Vedas can be obtained from a teacher's mouth only after a very long time. Therefore I have taken up this highest effort.

verses.text: इन्द्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
अमार्ग एष विप्रर्षे येन त्वं यातुमिच्छसि ।
किं विघातेन ते विप्र गच्छाधीहि गुरोर्मुखात् ॥

meaning.en: This is not the way, brahmin sage, by which you wish to go. Why destroy yourself, brahmin? Go and learn from a teacher's mouth.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा गतः शक्रो यवक्रीरपि भारत ।
भूय एवाकरोद्यत्नं तपस्यमितविक्रम ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, Indra left, and Yavakri, Bharata, of boundless prowess, went on with his austerity again.

verses.text:
घोरेण तपसा राजंस्तप्यमानो महातपाः ।
संतापयामास भृशं देवेन्द्रमिति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: King, we have heard that, scorched by dreadful austerity, that great ascetic caused Indra great torment.

verses.text:
तं तथा तप्यमानं तु तपस्तीव्रं महामुनिम् ।
उपेत्य बलभिद्देवो वारयामास वै पुनः ॥

meaning.en: The god who split Bala came again to the great sage as he practised that fierce austerity, and stopped him once more.

verses.text:
अशक्योऽर्थः समारब्धो नैतद्बुद्धिकृतं तव ।
प्रतिभास्यन्ति वै वेदास्तव चैव पितुश्च ते ॥

meaning.en: You have begun something impossible. This is not wise of you. The Vedas will come to you and to your father on their own.

verses.text: यवक्रीरुवाच

meaning.en: Yavakri said:

verses.text:
न चैतदेवं क्रियते देवराज ममेप्सितम् ।
महता नियमेनाहं तप्स्ये घोरतरं तपः ॥

meaning.en: This is not being done as I want it, king of the gods. I shall practise a still more terrible austerity, with great discipline.

verses.text:
समिद्धेऽग्नावुपकृत्याङ्गमङ्गं
होष्यामि वा मघवंस्तन्निबोध ।
यद्येतदेवं न करोषि कामं
ममेप्सितं देवराजेह सर्वम् ॥

meaning.en: Know this, Maghavan: I shall cut off limb after limb and offer them in the kindled fire, if you do not grant me everything I wish.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
निश्चयं तमभिज्ञाय मुनेस्तस्य महात्मनः ।
प्रतिवारणहेत्वर्थं बुद्ध्या संचिन्त्य बुद्धिमान् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the great-souled sage's resolve, the wise Indra considered how to stop him.

verses.text:
तत इन्द्रोऽकरोद्रूपं ब्राह्मणस्य तपस्विनः ।
अनेकशतवर्षस्य दुर्बलस्य सयक्ष्मणः ॥

meaning.en: Then Indra took the form of an ascetic brahmin, many hundreds of years old, weak and consumptive.

verses.text:
यवक्रीतस्य यत्तीर्थमुचितं शौचकर्मणि ।
भागीरथ्यां तत्र सेतुं वालुकाभिश्चकार सः ॥

meaning.en: At the ford of the Bhagirathi that Yavakri used for his ablutions, Indra began to make a dam of sand.

verses.text:
यदास्य वदतो वाक्यं न स चक्रे द्विजोत्तमः ।
वालुकाभिस्ततः शक्रो गङ्गां समभिपूरयन् ॥

meaning.en: When the best of brahmins paid no heed to what he said, Indra went on filling the Ganga with sand.

verses.text:
वालुकामुष्टिमनिशं भागीरथ्यां व्यसर्जयत् ।
सेतुमभ्यारभच्छक्रो यवक्रीतं निदर्शयन् ॥

meaning.en: Without pause Indra threw handfuls of sand into the Bhagirathi and kept building the dam, in front of Yavakri.

verses.text:
तं ददर्श यवक्रीस्तु यत्नवन्तं निबन्धने ।
प्रहसंश्चाब्रवीद्वाक्यमिदं स मुनिपुंगवः ॥

meaning.en: Yavakri saw him labouring to dam the river, and the best of sages said to him, laughing:

verses.text:
किमिदं वर्तते ब्रह्मन्किं च ते ह चिकीर्षितम् ।
अतीव हि महान्यत्नः क्रियतेऽयं निरर्थकः ॥

meaning.en: What are you doing, brahmin? What do you intend? This very great effort is entirely pointless.

verses.text: इन्द्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
बन्धिष्ये सेतुना गङ्गां सुखः पन्था भविष्यति ।
क्लिश्यते हि जनस्तात तरमाणः पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: I will bridge the Ganga with a dam and the road will be easy. People, my child, are put to trouble crossing again and again.

verses.text: यवक्रीरुवाच

meaning.en: Yavakri said:

verses.text:
नायं शक्यस्त्वया बद्धुं महानोघः कथंचन ।
अशक्याद्विनिवर्तस्व शक्यमर्थं समारभ ॥

meaning.en: You cannot dam this great flood in any way. Give up what cannot be done and begin what can.

verses.text: इन्द्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
यथैव भवता चेदं तपो वेदार्थमुद्यतम् ।
अशक्यं तद्वदस्माभिरयं भारः समुद्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Just as this austerity of yours for the sake of the Veda is impossible, so I too have undertaken this impossible burden.

verses.text: यवक्रीरुवाच

meaning.en: Yavakri said:

verses.text:
यथा तव निरर्थोऽयमारम्भस्त्रिदशेश्वर ।
तथा यदि ममापीदं मन्यसे पाकशासन ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the gods, if you think my undertaking is as pointless as yours,

verses.text:
क्रियतां यद्भवेच्छक्यं मया सुरगणेश्वर ।
वरांश्च मे प्रयच्छान्यान्यैरन्यान्भवितास्म्यति ॥

meaning.en: then do what you can, lord of the host of gods, and give me other boons, by which I may surpass others.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
तस्मै प्रादाद्वरानिन्द्र उक्तवान्यान्महातपाः ।
प्रतिभास्यन्ति ते वेदाः पित्रा सह यथेप्सिताः ॥

meaning.en: Indra granted him the boons that the great ascetic named: "The Vedas will shine in you with your father, as you wish."

verses.text:
यच्चान्यत्काङ्क्षसे कामं यवक्रीर्गम्यतामिति ।
स लब्धकामः पितरमुपेत्याथ ततोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: "And whatever else you desire, Yavakri, go." Having got his wishes, he went to his father and spoke.
